---
title: "Prism in Typst"
subtitle: "The same source, resolved for another format."
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 2.5cm
      y: 2.5cm
---

This page is part of the documentation site and is rendered to Typst, so every prefix on it resolves against that format rather than against HTML.

::: {atelier-html:style="color: rgb(178,34,34);" typst:style="color: rgb(0,0,255);"}
This paragraph asks for one colour under the site format and blue under Typst.
In this PDF it is blue.
:::

::: {default:style="color: rgb(100,100,100);" atelier-html:style="color: rgb(178,34,34);"}
This one names no Typst value, so the default applies and it is grey.
On the HTML pages the exact match wins instead.
:::

::: {slide:style="color: rgb(0,128,128);"}
This one targets the slide formats only, so nothing applies here and the text is ordinary.
:::

The examples page shows the same three paragraphs resolved for HTML.
